title: Uniform bounds and L¹-closeness for the rescaled Hausdorff measures at a good point
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ = μHE[n], ω_n = unitBallVolume n, |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm, ‖·‖ the operator norm on MultiVector P n = Λ_n(ℝ^P) and ‖·‖ₑ its [0,∞]-valued version. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel with θ(x) > 0 for x ∈ M, ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) strongly measurable with |ζ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x and all n-covectors α, and for each x ∈ M an n-covector β with |β| ≤ 1 and ζ(x)(β) = 1; let μ = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density x ↦ ofReal θ(x). Let a ∈ M and η₁ > 0 with (L) ofReal η₁ ≤ liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(a))/(ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)), (U) limsup_{r↓0} Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_r(a))/(ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)) ≤ 1, and (D) (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_r(a)} ‖θ(x)ζ(x) − θ(a)ζ(a)‖ₑ dHⁿ(x))/(ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)) → 0 as r ↓ 0 (limits along 𝓝[>] 0). Assume moreover Hⁿ(M) < ∞, and let λ_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) with λ_i → 0. Put N_i := blowUpMap a λ_i '' M = {λ_i⁻¹(x − a) : x ∈ M} and ν_i := Hⁿ⌞N_i. Then: (a) sup_i ν_i(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; (b) limsup_i ν_i(B̄_R(0)) ≤ ω_n·ofReal(Rⁿ) for every R > 0; (c) for every R > 0, eventually in i, ofReal(η₁/(4θ(a)))·(ω_n·ofReal(Rⁿ)) ≤ ν_i(B̄_R(0)); (d) for every R > 0, ∫⁻_{B̄_R(0)} ‖θ(a + λ_iy)ζ(a + λ_iy) − θ(a)ζ(a)‖ₑ dν_i(y) → 0 as i → ∞.
